name: Aviation
author: Sixth Front
description: A battle type: pick AVIATION on the main menu, then a map (Highlands, Dune Sea, Fjordland: each about 3 km across) and a mode (Conquest with sky zones, Air Superiority, Ground Strike). Everyone flies: the Jets and Bombers mods (switched on for you) with up to 10 aircraft a side. Every airbase is guarded by C-RAM guns that shoot down bombs, rockets and missiles and hose down low-flying aircraft (you hear the alarm and the beeps when one tracks you). In Ground Strike, bomb the enemy base: radar, fuel depot, hangars, command bunker and the C-RAM sites. Your own aircraft come back about 6 seconds after you lose them: with 1 aircraft in your crew you get 3 spawns in it, with 2 the first gets 2 spawns and the second 1, with 3 or 4 each gets 1. Matchmaking: the bots on both sides fly only the aircraft within one rank of your best one, so a beginner's F-16 meets MiG-29s and Su-27s, not Su-57s. The C-RAM guns fire a visible stream of glowing tracers.

battle.name: AVIATION
battle.tagline: Three kilometres of sky. Take the sky zones, win air superiority or bomb the enemy airbase, while its C-RAM guns fill the air with tracers.

modes.name: CONQUEST
modes.blurb: Fly through the sky zones to take them

modes.name: AIR SUPERIORITY
modes.blurb: No zones: shoot down their air force
